source_correspondence: Per-stream RMS, prepared1+raw norm, flattened low-rank down/H then SiLU/up/sigmoid and weighted mean match pinned gated_residual_mix/_mix_ref.
Local loader preparation casts norm toFP32 before adding1 exactly once and casts projection tables toFP16; this does not claim Sushi table dtype parity.
Residual injection uses raw incoming streams plus2*sigmoid(normalized-flat inject/H) times sublayer output. No DeepSeek Sinkhorn/combine matrix.
Final combine-less learned mixer precedes the head with no extra RMSNorm; streams_mean is separately labeled feature export, not head collapse.
adjoint_review: Weighted-mix direct and gate-dependent paths both propagate through normalized streams.
Post-gate derivative post*(1-post/2) propagates through inject/H into the same normalization adjoint.
Residual partials preserve identity dx, sum gate-weighted doutput for dy, and sum y*doutput for dpost; composed test feeds dpost back through mix.
Independent scalar finite differences test site/final and composed input/output derivatives at rtol2e-7/atol2e-8.
limits: NumPy math/FP64 continuous adjoints do not establish rounded Torch/CUDA/Metal/Sushi parity.
No checkpoint payload, attention/GDN/MoE/PLE sublayer, full model, parameter gradients or training integration.
A caller composing a real sublayer must also propagate dy through that sublayer and its mixed input; the reference returns partial adjoints, not a complete block gradient.
source_provenance verifies an explicit snapshot when called; arithmetic methods do not auto-authenticate source bytes on every invocation.
